verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Azure has a REST API reference covering curl usage, client libraries and Entra ID auth, but nothing documents an interactive reference where examples can be run from the docs. The CLI's interactive commands, tab-completion and Cloud Shell availability are adjacent tooling, not runnable API reference examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
